content.text: Browser-only 401 but curl works points at a CORS preflight problem: the browser fires an OPTIONS preflight before the real request. Let me inspect what the proxy returns for that preflight.

content.text: Found it. Two compounding problems. (1) The OPTIONS preflight is hitting our auth middleware and getting a 401, because browsers never send the Authorization header on a preflight — the middleware runs before the CORS handler, so the preflight dies. (2) Even if it passed, the response's Access-Control-Allow-Headers only lists Content-Type, not Authorization, so the browser would refuse to send the token on the real request. Fix: short-circuit OPTIONS before the auth middleware and add Authorization to Access-Control-Allow-Headers. After that the browser completes the preflight and sends the real request with the token, which 200s.
